product_metadata.title: ES Handmade Chinese Style Traditional Cooking Casserole, Hong Kong Style Rice/Porridge Pot Clay(7.1"=18cm) with single handle
features: Made from the oldest dragon kiln by a type lead-free and non-toxic fine clay, a great cooking tool for making soup, stew, and rice.
Classic clay handmade casserole which helps food get cooked evenly.
Initial Use Instruction: Soak with water for half hour to 1 1/2 hours, clean and let it dry, then start to use it.
description: Traditional handmade clay pot. Used in many traditional Chinese recipes such as clay pot rice. Please note, due to handmade nature, product may have slight imperfections in appearance but will not affect its quality and usage. Suitable for 2-3 people serving capacity.
